content.value_statement: Medical device teams must keep ISO 13485 processes, records, audits, and reviews aligned. This skill guides QMS planning, documentation, monitoring, CAPA, and certification preparation.
actual_capabilities: Guides ISO 13485 gap analysis, QMS planning, and implementation roadmap development.
Explains document control workflows for creation, approval, distribution, review, retention, and disposal.
Structures management review inputs, action tracking, and follow-up verification.
Supports risk-based internal audit planning, execution, reporting, and corrective action follow-up.
Covers design controls, ISO 14971 risk management integration, supplier quality, and QMS performance metrics.
Helps prepare certification maintenance activities, surveillance audit preparation, and inspection readiness.
limitations: It does not certify an organization or replace an accredited certification body.
It does not replace qualified regulatory, legal, or notified body advice.
It requires current procedures, records, metrics, and product context from the user.
The included supporting script, reference, and asset files are placeholders, not complete operational tools.

use_cases.title: Build a QMS Implementation Plan
use_cases.description: Create a phased ISO 13485 implementation roadmap from current-state gaps, resources, owners, and target certification dates.
use_cases.target_user: Quality managers at early-stage medical device companies

use_cases.title: Prepare Management Review Inputs
use_cases.description: Organize audit results, complaints, CAPA status, process metrics, supplier data, and improvement recommendations for leadership review.
use_cases.target_user: Quality assurance leaders and management representatives

use_cases.title: Strengthen Internal Audit Follow-Up
use_cases.description: Plan risk-based audits, classify findings, connect nonconformities to CAPA, and verify corrective action effectiveness.

prompt_templates.title: Start a QMS Gap Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a structured ISO 13485 assessment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our current ISO 13485 QMS status. Ask me for the minimum inputs needed, then create a gap analysis outline by clause.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Document Control Process
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a procedure framework.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a document control procedure outline for ISO 13485 clause 4.2.3, including approvals, version control, distribution, retention, and obsolete documents.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Internal Audit Program
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for risk-based audit planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a risk-based internal audit program for our medical device QMS. Include audit scope, frequency, auditor competence, reporting, and CAPA follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize QMS Performance Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request linking metrics, CAPA, suppliers, and management review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these QMS metrics and open CAPAs. Identify trends, management review inputs, supplier concerns, and improvement priorities for the next quarter.

output_examples.input: We need a first ISO 13485 implementation roadmap for a 20-person device startup.
output_examples.output: A phased roadmap with gap assessment, document hierarchy, process owners, training milestones, audit readiness steps, and certification preparation activities.

output_examples.input: Prepare management review topics from complaints, audit findings, CAPA delays, and supplier scorecards.
output_examples.output: A management review agenda with required inputs, trend summaries, decision points, assigned actions, and follow-up verification items.

output_examples.input: Our internal audit found repeated document approval delays.
output_examples.output: A finding summary with likely process causes, CAPA framing, effectiveness checks, and document control improvements.

best_practices: Provide current procedures, process maps, audit records, CAPA status, and metrics before asking for recommendations.
Ask for clause references and objective evidence lists when preparing audits or management reviews.
Have qualified quality or regulatory personnel review outputs before using them in controlled QMS records.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated procedures as approved controlled documents without formal review and approval.
Do not use the skill to bypass certification body, notified body, or regulatory authority requirements.
Do not request generic QMS plans without device type, organization scope, process maturity, and market context.

faq.question: Can this skill create ISO 13485 procedures?
faq.answer: It can draft procedure outlines and content, but your organization must review, approve, and control them under your QMS.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee ISO 13485 certification?
faq.answer: No. Certification depends on implementation evidence, audit results, and decisions by an accredited certification body.

faq.question: Can it help with internal audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help plan risk-based audits, define scope, prepare checklists, summarize findings, and connect follow-up to CAPA.

faq.question: Does it cover medical device design controls?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers ISO 13485 design control stages and links them to risk management and product lifecycle activities.

faq.question: Can it replace a quality manager?
faq.answer: No. It supports quality management work, but accountable personnel must make decisions and approve controlled outputs.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide product scope, markets, current procedures, records, audit history, CAPA data, supplier data, and performance metrics.
